You are an expert chemist, your task is to predict the yield of reaction using your experienced chemical yield prediction knowledge.
Please strictly follow the format, no other information can be provided. Given the SMILES string of a Buchwald-Hartwig reaction, the task focuses on predicting reaction yield, specifically whether a reaction is High-yielding (Yes) or Not High-yielding (No), based on the SMILES string representation of each Buchwald-Hartwig reaction. The reactants are separated by '.', which are separated from the product by '>>'. High-yielding reaction means the yield rate of the reaction is above 70. You will be provided with several examples molecules. Please answer with only Yes or No.The Reaction is as follows
CCc1ccc(Cl)cc1.Cc1ccc(N)cc1.O=S(=O)(O[Pd]1c2ccccc2-c2ccccc2N-1)C(F)(F)F.COc1ccc(OC)c(P([C@]23C[C@H]4C[C@H](C[C@H](C4)C2)C3)[C@]23C[C@H]4C[C@H](C[C@H](C4)C2)C3)c1-c1c(C(C)C)cc(C(C)C)cc1C(C)C.CN(C)C(=NC(C)(C)C)N(C)C.Cc1ccno1>>CCc1ccc(Nc2ccc(C)cc2)cc1You have to output your judge, which is "Yes" or "No", and exactly follow the output format, which is as follows:
{"answer": "The answer you judge"}. I don't need any explanation, you just need to output your judgment in the format.

Please use your tools to analyze and solve this problem accurately.

1. [ ] Identify the Buchwald–Hartwig coupling partners and catalyst/ligand system from the reaction SMILES.
2. [ ] Assess whether the substrate and conditions are consistent with a yield above 70%.
3. [ ] Return the requested JSON judgment only.

Tool call: go_search_agent
Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 2, 'search_target': 'Assess the likely experimental yield classification (>70% yes/no) for the Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 1-chloro-4-ethylbenzene with p-toluidine, yielding N-(4-ethylphenyl)-p-toluidine, using a BrettPhos-like bulky biaryl phosphine Pd precatalyst, strong guanidine base, and isoxazole additive. Find matching reaction records or closely analogous substrate/condition yields.'}

**Likely classification: No** — the reported yield is not >70%.

The ORD search found an exact match for 1-chloro-4-ethylbenzene and p-toluidine. The closest record to the specified conditions—t-BuXPhos, MTBD, and a phenyl-isoxazole additive—reported **16.2% yield** in DMSO at 60 °C for 16 hours. Four other exact-match records reported **15.2–26.6%**; none exceeded 70%.

These are recorded experimental matches, not a general prediction for every possible protocol.
